title: Golden workbook (gt_10_golden.xlsx) contains unconverged circular-reference cached values and fails its own verifier self-check
evidence: The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1, `mode: values`) force-recalculates the submitted workbook once in LibreOffice (`managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True)`) and compares the recalculated values against the raw cached values of `gt_10_golden.xlsx` (which is NOT recalculated). However, `Model` has an unconverged circular reference in its debt/cash sweep (`I195` Paydown `=IF($H201=0,0,MIN(MAX((-I193+-I194),-(I146+I194+(I$182-$K$11))),0))` references Ending Cash `I$182` instead of Beginning Cash `I$180`, while `I181 = I146+I194+I195+I205` and `I182 = SUM(I180:I181)`), which oscillates between ~+2.05 and ~-0.11 on every recalculation pass instead of converging (where mathematically `I182` should equal Minimum Cash `K11 = 1.0`, `I181 = 0`, and `I195 = -I146 = -2.0012`). Because `gt_10_golden.xlsx` stores an arbitrary mid-oscillation snapshot (`Model!I182 = -0.111997214653663`, `Model!I121 = -3.00406239978358`, `Model!I195 = -3.0727010080648`), running `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` on `gt_10_golden.xlsx` itself scores 0.0 (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.1257. 167 cell error(s): Modification error at Model!I121: answer=-3.00406239978358, output=-3.08777611992694; ... Model!I181: answer=-1.11199721465366, output=1.04921163134373; Model!I182: answer=-0.111997214653663, output=2.04921163134373`). Similarly, applying the exact 17 ground-truth formula fixes to the input workbook and running the verifier produces 182 modification errors (`modification 0.0471`, score 0.0).
confirmation: gt_10_golden.xlsx Model caches an inconsistent circular state. J196 '=SUM(J193:J195)' is cached at 26.039, but its inputs sum to 25.866, and the I195 paydown references I$182, so the sweep oscillates. The verifier recalculates only the output in LibreOffice and needs every modification cell within 1

title: Ground-truth workbook fails its own verifier after LibreOffice recalculation, so the task cannot be passed
evidence: The verifier recalculates the agent's output in LibreOffice (force_recalculation=True). It then compares the result with the golden file's cached Excel values at 1% relative tolerance, and every modification cell must match. I copied gt_10_golden.xlsx as output.xlsx and ran verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells with the spec parameters. Result: score=0.0, 'FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.1257. 167 cell error(s): Modification error at Model!I121: answer=-3.00406239978358, output=-3.08777611992694; Model!I122: answer=-6.0244, output=-6.1081; Model!I123: answer=-0.033967, output=-0.034439; Model!I126: answer=-4.5183, output=-4.5811 ...'. The cause is a circular model. Both input and GT have <calcPr iterate="true" iterateCount="100" iterateDelta="0.0001"/>. Interest on Cash (Model!I183), ABL interest (I197) and Term Loan interest (I207) feed interest expense (row 121), and row 121 feeds back into cash flow (row 146) and the balances. LibreOffice's iterative solver converges to values about 2-3% away from Excel's cached values, outside the 1% tolerance. The untouched input shows the same drift: cached I121=-1.7707, but LibreOffice gives -1.5174. Only 191 cells in the 294,669-cell range are modification cells, and 167 of them fail even for the perfect answer. The verifier is the only check (weight 1, binary pass/fail), so every run scores 0 whatever its quality.
confirmation: gt_10_golden.xlsx Model caches an inconsistent circular state. J196 '=SUM(J193:J195)' is cached at 26.039, but its inputs sum to 25.866, and the I195 paydown references I$182, so the sweep oscillates. The verifier recalculates only the output in LibreOffice and needs every modification cell within 1

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check is a trivial fail and gives false negative verdicts due to oscillating circular references during forced recalculation
evidence: Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) scores 0.0. Reconstructing the outputs from the trajectories: in unit 2 (step [42]) and unit 3 (step [33]/[46]), the agent correctly identified and fixed all 15 `AVERAGE` formulas on the `Model` sheet (`I183:M183` from `AVERAGE(col180:col182)` to `AVERAGE(col180,col182)`, `I197:M197` from `AVERAGE(col193:col196)` to `AVERAGE(col193,col196)`, and `I207:M207` from `AVERAGE(col204:col206)` to `AVERAGE(col204,col206)`), which are the exact `Model` sheet formula changes in `gt_10_golden.xlsx`. However, because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` runs `managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True)` on the submitted file while comparing against the un-recalculated cached values in `gt_10_golden.xlsx`, the oscillating circular reference in `Model` rows 181-182 and 195 causes every single-pass or multi-pass LibreOffice recalculation to diverge from `gt_10_golden.xlsx`'s cached values (which correspond to 10 sequential `calculateAll()` passes). Specifically, unit 2 saved the patched XML without recalculating so the verifier performed 1 pass (`Model!I121` output=-3.119722 vs answer=-3.004062, 184 cell errors, modification=0.0366), while unit 3 recalculated once via UNO before saving so the verifier performed a 2nd pass (`Model!I181` output=-1.768152 vs answer=-1.111997, 119 cell errors, modification=0.3770). Even `gt_10_golden.xlsx` itself scores 0.0 (modification=0.1257, 167 cell errors) when passed to `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, making it impossible for any normal submission to pass.
confirmation: gt_10_golden.xlsx Model caches an inconsistent circular state. J196 '=SUM(J193:J195)' is cached at 26.039, but its inputs sum to 25.866, and the I195 paydown references I$182, so the sweep oscillates. The verifier recalculates only the output in LibreOffice and needs every modification cell within 1
